'''Padry''' is a footman to [[Paers]] and [[Culen]], two [[Murandian]] [[Hunters of the Horn]] from [[Minde]]. 

== Activities ==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] orders him and his lords out of [[Maerone]] for manhandling [[Olver]], who was sitting on Paers' horse.{{ref/book|6|5}}
